modules.title: 三类地址各自能被谁访问
地址范围决定谁能访问

items.title: 127.0.0.1：本机回环地址
items.text: localhost 和 127.0.0.1 指向当前设备的回环接口；别人使用这个地址，访问的是他们自己的设备。

items.title: 局域网地址：通常在相应网络内可达
items.text: 192.168.x.x、10.x.x.x 这类私有地址通常在对应局域网内路由；能否连上仍要看服务监听、防火墙和网络配置。

items.title: 公网地址：可经互联网路由，仍受配置限制
items.text: 公网地址可能经互联网路由到主机，但仍需有服务监听并允许访问；域名是便于记忆的名称，会解析到 IP 地址。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 服务监听地址和访问地址是两回事：只监听本机时，即使告诉同事局域网地址也连不上。排查“别人访问不了”时，先看服务监听范围，再看地址类型。

lessonPractice.title: 本地项目跑在 localhost:3000，想让同事访问你的开发服务。地址该怎么给？

options.label: localhost 只指向对方自己的电脑；要用局域网地址或部署到公网
options.feedback: 对。localhost 是每台电脑对自己的称呼；同事访问需要局域网地址或公网地址。

options.label: 直接给 localhost:3000，地址一样就能访问
options.feedback: localhost 在同事电脑上指向他自己，访问不到你的服务。

options.label: 只给端口 3000 就够了
options.feedback: 端口只是同一设备上的入口，没有 IP 或域名无法定位到哪台设备。

en.title: Your project runs on localhost:3000 and a colleague wants to access your dev server. What address should you give?

options.label: localhost points only at their own computer; use a LAN address or deploy publicly
options.feedback: Correct. localhost is each machine's name for itself; a colleague needs a LAN or public address.

options.label: Just give localhost:3000; the same address should work
options.feedback: localhost on the colleague's machine points at themselves, not your service.

options.label: The port 3000 alone is enough
options.feedback: A port is only an entry on one device; without an IP or domain, no device can be located.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 本地服务跑在 localhost:3000，同事访问不了。请告诉我本机的局域网地址，并确认开发服务监听的是所有网卡而不是仅本机；如果需要在公网访问，说明该部署到哪里。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The local service runs on localhost:3000 and my colleague cannot reach it. Tell me this machine's LAN address and confirm the dev server listens on all interfaces rather than localhost only; if public access is needed, explain where to deploy.

learning.assumes: You have seen localhost or numeric addresses, or heard that others cannot reach your service.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether an address points at localhost, the LAN, or the public internet.

modules.title: Who can reach each kind of address
Address scope decides who can reach it

items.title: 127.0.0.1: only this machine
items.text: localhost and 127.0.0.1 mean this very computer; anyone else using the address reaches their own machine.

items.title: LAN address: routed within a network
items.text: Private addresses such as 192.168.x.x and 10.x.x.x can be routed within their network; the service must also listen on a reachable interface, and firewall and network rules must allow the connection.

items.title: A public address: potentially reachable from the internet
items.text: A public address can be routed from the internet, but connections still depend on ports, service listening, firewalls, and other access rules; a domain name resolves to an address.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Listening address and access address are two things: if the service listens on localhost only, even giving a colleague the LAN address fails. When others cannot reach it, check the listening scope first, then the address type.

distinctions.label: Domain
distinctions.text: A domain is a human-friendly name resolved to an IP before access; an IP is a device's numeric address on the network.

distinctions.label: Port
distinctions.text: An IP locates which device; a port distinguishes services on the same device. Together they form a complete address.
